what: Per-simulation values for the standard PM panel — Calc_PM_Stats
title: Per-simulation values for the standard PM panel — Calc_PM_Stats
text: fixed panel performance metrics [Calc_PMs()] (`PM`/`Window` combinations), keeps every simulation's value instead collapsing `@Mean`. Intended populating `Slick::Boxplot()`/ `Slick::Quilt()`/`Slick::Spider()` `Value` arrays, need `Sim` dimension averaging subset selected OMs (`Slick` `App()`) mean raw per-sim values, mean per-OM means [Calc_PMs()] give. probability-scale PMs (`Safety`, `Stability`, `Status`) per-sim value read `@Prob` (already 0/1 indicator `@Mean` averages – confirmed identical `@Mean` re-averaged). natural-scale PMs (`Yield`, `Depletion_Min`, `SB_SBMSY`, `F_FMSY`), leave `@Prob` `NA`, value read `@Stat` instead (slot [Calc_PMs()] averages ). `Safety`, `Stability`, `Status`, `Depletion_Min` naturally 0-1 scale safe use directly `Spider()` chart (requires every PI 0-1 0-100 scale); `Yield`, `SB_SBMSY`, `F_FMSY` left `Spider()`.

title: Per-simulation values for the standard PM panel — Calc_PM_Stats
Per-simulation values for the standard PM panel — Calc_PM_Stats
text: MSE `mse` object (list `mse` objects, combined via [MSEtool::CombineMSE()]). BlimFrac Numeric. Fraction `SBMSY` used safety limit, passed straight `Lim` (`Definition = 'SBiomass'`). StabilityThreshold Numeric. Passed [MSEtool::PM_Stability()]. silent Logical. Suppress [MSEtool::CombineMSE()] summary message `MSE` `list`. Default `TRUE`.

title: Per-simulation values for the standard PM panel — Calc_PM_Stats
text: tidy `data.frame` columns `PM`, `Window`, `PI`, `Stock`,   `MP`, `Sim`, `Value`. `PI` `PM`/`Window` pair collapsed   single code expected `analysis/08-Create-Slick.R`'s `PM_Codes` (see   [.PM_Code()]).

what: Tabulate a standard set of performance metrics, for comparing CMPs — Calc_PMs
title: Tabulate a standard set of performance metrics, for comparing CMPs — Calc_PMs
text: Runs fixed panel performance metrics eg [MSEtool::PM_Yield()], [MSEtool::PM_Safety()], [MSEtool::PM_Stability()], [MSEtool::PM_Status()],  stacks `@Mean` (`Stock x MP`) slots one tidy table,  quick side--side comparison candidate CMPs.

title: Tabulate a standard set of performance metrics, for comparing CMPs — Calc_PMs
Tabulate a standard set of performance metrics, for comparing CMPs — Calc_PMs
text: MSE `mse` object (list `mse` objects, combined via [MSEtool::CombineMSE()]). BlimFrac Numeric. Fraction `SBMSY` used safety limit, passed straight `Lim` (`Definition = 'SBiomass'`). StabilityThreshold Numeric. Passed [MSEtool::PM_Stability()]. silent Logical. Suppress [MSEtool::CombineMSE()] summary message `MSE` `list`. Default `TRUE`. StabilityThreshold30 Numeric. second, looser [MSEtool::PM_Stability()] check (reported `Stability30`) alongside Resolution-24-09-standard 20% one – e.g. useful CMP clears 30% year--year change bound comfortably stricter 20% one, distinguishing "somewhat stable" "stable ". `ATV` ([MSEtool::PM_AAVY()], mean year--year yield variability, unthresholded) also always included.

title: Tabulate a standard set of performance metrics, for comparing CMPs — Calc_PMs
text: tidy `data.frame` columns `PM`, `Window`, `PI`, `Stock`,   `MP`, `Mean`. `PI` `PM`/`Window` pair collapsed single   code expected `analysis/08-Create-Slick.R`'s `PM_Codes` (see   [.PM_Code()]).

what: Cap the year-on-year change in a management procedure's TAC recommendation — Cap_TAC_Change
title: Cap the year-on-year change in a management procedure's TAC recommendation — Cap_TAC_Change

title: Cap the year-on-year change in a management procedure's TAC recommendation — Cap_TAC_Change

text: NewTAC Numeric. Proposed TAC. LastTAC Numeric. Previous TAC. MaxChange Numeric, length 1 2. Maximum proportional decrease/ increase permitted relative `LastTAC`. single value (e.g. `0.4`) applies symmetrically (-40%/+40%); `c(MaxDown, MaxUp)` (e.g. `c(0.4, 0.2)`) applies asymmetrically.

title: Cap the year-on-year change in a management procedure's TAC recommendation — Cap_TAC_Change
text: `list` elements `TAC` (capped TAC) `Log` (`NULL`,   warning message `NewTAC` non-finite).
